ITodoListSystemSetting.description:
System-wide application configuration and global settings object.

Provides a centralized representation for storing key/value pairs, flags, and operational parameters used by the todo list application at runtime. Each object represents a distinct configuration setting and is mapped directly to a row in the todo_list_system_settings Prisma table.

Typical usage includes storing site-wide feature switches, maintenance flags, version numbers, and other application settings that need to be referenced by business logic or admin operations. Includes full audit metadata for lifecycle and change tracking.

page.description: The page number for pagination, starting from 1.

limit.description: The maximum number of settings to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100 for performance and usability.

sort.description: Sorting criteria for listing results. May include field names such as 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'key', or 'version', with optional prefix for direction (e.g., '-created_at' for descending order).

key.description: Filter for exact or partial match on the configuration key. Supports case-insensitive and substring search.

value.description: Filter for exact or partial match on the configuration value. Supports substring search and is useful for finding settings related to specific features.

version.description: Filter for a specific configuration version.

description.description: Filter for configuration entries with descriptions that match this value, case-insensitive and supporting partial search.

ITodoListSystemSetting.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering request structure for querying system-wide configuration settings records.

Allows administrative users to search, filter, and sort results from the todo_list_system_settings table when managing application configuration. Includes pagination parameters (page, limit), sort options, and filters for key, value, version, and description. Used by admin endpoints for configuration management and global application status reporting.

key.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting. Must be unique system-wide and adhere to upper-case ASCII alphanumeric and underscore characters. Used by the application logic to reference individual runtime or operational settings. Example: FEATURE_ENABLE_XYZ, API_TIMEOUT, SITE_VERSION.

value.description: Value assigned to the configuration key. Interpreted by business logic as needed: boolean, integer, string, URI, feature code, or serialized structure. The format and constraints depend on the targeted setting type. Required for all new configuration records.

Field may be null if no description is provided.

ITodoListSystemSetting.ICreate.description:

Allows administrators to register a new runtime option, environment variable, or feature toggle in the managed configuration table. Enforces system-unique key; requires value assignment. Description is optional but recommended for audit and clarity. Settings may govern application features, API keys, version numbers, or global flags. Timestamps, version, and id are automatic system fields not to be supplied on creation.

Field may be explicitly set to null to remove descriptive context for this setting.

ITodoListSystemSetting.IUpdate.description:
DTO schema for updating an existing system-wide configuration setting (todo_list_system_settings).

Allows administrators to modify the value or description of a setting referenced by its key (provided in the path, not the body). Every update increments the version and refreshes update timestamp. Only value and description are modifiable; key remains constant. Used for runtime configuration changes, feature switches, or environment parameter updates. Records updated_by in audit, enforces admin authorization.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the todo item.

Corresponds to the primary key in the database. Used to reference and update this todo in all API operations.

Prevents user ID leaks and supports anti-circular reference best practices. Includes id and primary display field; does not include unbounded relationships or sensitive data.

title.description:
Short title of the todo item.

Current workflow status for the todo.

ITodoListTodo.ISummary.description:

ITodoListAuditLog.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a system audit log entry for privileged administrative events and compliance tracking.

Provides concise information about an audit event, listing its actor (administrator), event category, affected target, main time, and a minimal narrative for administrative review, compliance reporting, or quick filtering. Serves as a lightweight alternative to the full audit log record, optimized for list display and reporting scenarios.

Intended for use cases such as audit history lists, compliance dashboards, and search/filtering endpoints. Contains only essential attributes for quick reference, omitting full context and large text detail fields.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for this audit event entry. Use to trace the full immutable event record and for referencing in audit chain checks.

admin_id.description: Unique database identifier of the administrator responsible for this audit event. References todo_list_admins.id. This property is always present and is used for traceability of privileged actions across the system.

event_type.description: Short, machine-readable category indicating the type of event (e.g., 'user_deletion', 'todo_removed', 'permission_changed', 'login_failed', 'system_restart'). Enables rapid filtering and classification of event types in compliance reporting.

event_time.description: The UTC ISO8601 timestamp indicating when the audited event occurred. This is a precise time value and always present, used for chronological ordering and time-window queries.

target_user_id.description: Optional identifier of the user account directly affected by the event. May be null if event does not target a specific user (for example, system-level or generalized configuration actions). References todo_list_users.id if present.

details.description: Optional short narrative description or business context, intended for list or report display, subject to truncation based on interface needs. Use the full audit log entity for comprehensive details.

ITodoListSystemSetting.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a system-wide application configuration or runtime setting.

Lists essential fields required to identify, describe, and track global parameters that influence todo list application behavior. Designed for efficient search, filtering, and administrative overview in management interfaces.

Intended for display in settings panels or change history dashboards, this summary omits large full descriptions but retains references to all critical metadata such as key, value, and version information.

id.description: Primary key uniquely identifying this configuration record. Used for administrative change tracking and direct setting lookup.

key.description: Machine-unique identifier for this configuration setting. Used for application code lookups, filtering, and uniqueness enforcement. Must match ASCII alphanumeric with underscores and is unique system-wide.

value.description: Assigned value for this key. Can represent string, integer, boolean, or URI information depending on the setting. Represents the effective value at this version.

version.description: Monotonic version number incremented each time a modification occurs to this setting. Allows for configuration reloads and rollback tracking.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this setting record was originally created. Used for tracking lifecycle and configuration deployment timelines.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the most recent update to this setting record. Used to monitor configuration drift and support audit of operational changes.
